text: Appeal of Order to Comply (October 18, 2018) for 75 Huron Street.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated October 18, 2018, regarding the property located at 75 Huron Street, Folder No. 18 244770 PRS 00 IV, and doing so granted an extension of time to August 27, 2019.
